name: Trolls de Troy: La Cité de la mort rose
storyline:
Step into the shoes of a troll, the most fearsome creature in Troy! Play as the incorrigible Gnondpom and embark on a quest to find the cure for the terrible Pink Death epidemic ravaging the village of Phalompe.

Join Gnondpom and Tyneth in this unique adventure in the world of Troy, a blend of role-playing and action gameplay. Discover the world of Troy in 3D with stunning and realistic graphics, interact with all the characters, experience the quirky atmosphere of the comic book, solve puzzles, traverse labyrinths, and engage in combat...

Take cover, they're coming... swarms of flies, terrified peasants, fleeing dragons... yes, these are clear signs of their approach... brawls, wounds, and bruises are on the horizon.
summary: Trolls de Troy : La Cité de la mort rose on PC is an french exclusive adventure game based on the comic book universe by Mourier and Arleston. You control two little trolls who must fight against humans determined to wipe out your race by sending you to a beautiful, pink world, the complete opposite of your own. With some point-and-click elements, the game maintains the humorous tone of the series.
